questions.q: What comes next in the series? 25, 62, 123, 214, 341, …
questions.why: n³ − 2 for n = 3, 4, …. Next: 510. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: The speeds of a train and a man are 6 : 1. The 650 m train passes a pole in 1 minute 5 seconds. How long will the man take to cross a 240 m platform?
Find the smallest number which leaves remainder 7 when divided by 12, 18, 21 or 30.
Asha walks 3 m North, then turns left and walks 4 m, then turns right and walks 7 m, then turns right and walks 5 m. Which direction is Asha facing now?
questions.why: Follow each turn from the first direction: the last leg is towards the East. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: P provides premises (₹6,00,000); Q and R put in ₹3,00,000 and ₹5,00,000 cash. P gets rent of ₹5,000 a month; Q and R get 10% interest on capital; the rest is shared 3 : 2 : 5. If Q's total earning is ₹70,000, what was the gross profit?
questions.why: Q's interest 30,000, so his share is 40,000 = 2/10 of the remainder: 2,00,000. Add R's interest 50,000, Q's 30,000 and rent 60,000: 3,40,000. GPSC CBRT, Sep 2026.

questions.q: Karan beats Arjun by 10 m in a 100 m race. In a second race Karan starts 10 m behind the line. What happens?
questions.why: Speeds 100 : 90. While Karan runs 110 m, Arjun runs 99 m. GPSC CBRT, Jan 2024.

questions.q: The Banker's Gain on a bill due 2 years hence is ₹400. The Banker's Discount on the same bill for 4 years at the same rate is ₹3,200. Find the face value.
questions.why: BD for 2 years = 1600, TD = 1600 − 400 = 1200. FV = BD × TD ÷ BG = 4800. GPSC JSO pre-screening, Jun 2026.

questions.q: In a code language: 'There is Park' = 'nup yex ace'; 'People in Schools' = 'ybx cvu vcl'; 'Several Schools Are Present There' = 'cal del vuc ybx yex'; 'Park is Dark' = 'nup cig ace'; 'Dark People in Several Park' = 'vcl cal nup cig cvu'. What could 'cig ybx gkl vcl' stand for?
questions.why: cig = Dark, ybx = Schools, vcl = People; gkl is a new word. GPSC CBRT, Jul 2024.

questions.q: If SCHOOL is written as TEKSTR in a certain code, how is POTENCY written in that code?
questions.why: In the code the 1st letter moves 1 place, the 2nd 2 places, the 3rd 3 places, and so on: POTENCY → QQWISIF. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: At what time between 4 and 5 o’clock will the hands of the clock be together?
questions.why: 5.5M = 120, so M = 21 9/11 min ≈ 21 min 49 s. GPSC CBRT, Sep 2025.
